title: Running rows and the run pane show the relay board's information: pipeline, round, last heard, waiting steps, recent runs

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner 2026-10-23, comparing ork's Overview with slicer's relay board (b in slicer tui): bring the board's information into ork. Slicer's rules are in ../slicer/docs/tui.md:186-262 (the Relay board section) and are the source of truth for the wording and states. ork today shows one Running row per run (internal/tui/overview.go) and a step tree in the run pane (internal/tui/runtree.go, S55), but not: the role pipeline with the running role marked (implementer > reviewer > gate), the round (the number of implementer steps), last heard (time since the run's updated_at, which turns to a warning past 15 minutes and an error once stale at 30), steps not begun shown as waiting, the x N count per role, the failed-gate line, or the recent ended runs. The ledger fields already exist: slicer relay-run list --json gives per run id, items, begun_at, updated_at, state, outcome, counts and steps (role, agent, vendor, model, reasoning, phase, task, parent, begun_at, updated_at; internal/slicercli/types.go:132-166). The Overview reads only --active runs today (internal/slicercli/slicercli.go): the ended runs need a read without --active.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/slicercli/slicercli.go` and `types.go`: a RelayRuns read that includes ended runs (without --active), kept separate so the active read is unchanged; `internal/source/source.go` and `internal/daemon/*.go`: carry the recent ended runs (ended within the last hour) on the snapshot and status as *proposed* fields.
- `internal/tui/runtree.go`: the pipeline line (an architect leads it when the run has one; the running role in brackets; finished, running, failed and waiting roles marked), `round N`, `last heard`, waiting rows for roles not begun, the xN count and the failed-gate line, per ../slicer/docs/tui.md:186-262. Reuse runTreeStep and paneSteps.
- `internal/tui/overview.go`: the Running row gains the running role and last heard (S30 already adds the running step); a Recent section lists ended runs within the last hour (outcome glyph and word, items, how long it ran, ended N ago, impl/review/gate counts), dimmed, newest first.
- `internal/tui/theme.go`: the warning and error colours for last heard.
- Tests beside each; `testdata/golden/` (colour and monochrome); `docs/dashboard.md` and `docs/design.md` (Running section, run pane).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestPipelineLineMarksTheRunningRole: implementer, reviewer, gate with the running role in brackets; an architect leads when present; finished, failed and waiting roles are distinct (also in monochrome).
- TestRoundIsTheNumberOfImplementerSteps.
- TestLastHeardWarnsPastHalfTheStaleCutoffAndErrorsWhenStale: under 15 minutes dim, over 15 warning, stale (30) error; a stale run stops counting time at its last event.
- TestWaitingRolesShowAsWaiting: reviewer and gate rows show waiting before they begin.
- TestRepeatedRolesShowTheirCountAndTheGateFailLine.
- TestRecentSectionListsRunsEndedWithinTheHour: newest first, with outcome, items, run time, ended N ago and the role counts; a run ended 61 minutes ago is absent; the active read is unchanged.
- TestNarrowRowsDropCellsFromTheRightWhole: round goes first; the title is cut with an ellipsis.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome, at 100x30 and 80x24.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Read ../slicer/docs/tui.md:186-262 and write the failing tests first. 2. Add the ended-runs read and carry it on the snapshot. 3. Build the pipeline, round, last heard and waiting rows in runtree.go from the ledger steps. 4. Add the Running-row and Recent-section text in overview.go. 5. Update the docs. 6. go test ./internal/tui -update and review the golden diff. This is a UI slice: it gets the UI pass (r14, rule u10). Owner decision 2026-10-23: show the board information in ork (not only open slicer tui). Not in this slice: stopping or steering a run; any write.

Decided 2026-10-23 (owner), from the S97 preflight (six points): (1) Keep S55's tree (runtree.go:84-179, its ~15 tests and goldens unchanged in style) and add the pipeline line, round, last heard, waiting rows, the xN count and the failed-gate line around it; engine runs with no ledger (EngineRole only; paneSteps fallback) also get the pipeline, round and last heard from their role rounds. (2) Carry stale runs (state stale, not ended) into Running and the pane: read non-active runs too; a stale run is dimmed, labelled stale, stops counting time at its last event, and its last heard uses the error style; `~` marks started-but-not-running steps. (3) The Overview Running row (S30 already shows the role line and N of M steps): add a compact pipeline `[implementer]>reviewer>gate` and `heard 2m`; since a row is one pre-styled string, a `!` cue goes before heard past 15 minutes and `!!` once stale (the colour applies to the cell where it can); narrow rows drop cells whole from the right: heard first, then the pipeline, then the S30 role text; the first item's title is not added to the row. theme.go has no warn style: add one with a mono cue; tui.md:263-266 gives the mono rules for pipeline roles. (4) Recent: after Running and before Ready to land; heading `Recent`, empty state `none`; the rows are in the cursor order; Enter opens a read-only pane for the ended ledger run (paneRow and paneSteps must read ended runs too); run time and `ended N ago` come from begun_at and updated_at (the ledger has no ended_at); runs ended over an hour ago are hidden at render time using the injected clock (m.cfg.Now()). (5) Recent rows show a glyph and outcome word only (✓ pass, ✗ fail, ~ stopped), the items, run time, ended N ago and the implementer/reviewer/gate counts: no ○ and no status labels (no slicer config read). (6) The data comes from a second RelayRuns call (active=false) in Snapshot, not a new source.Part; the hour cutoff is applied at render; `ork status` output is unchanged. Nothing is open.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/slicercli ./internal/source ./internal/daemon ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] While a relay runs, the owner opens ork and sees the pipeline with the running role, the round, last heard, the waiting steps and the Recent list, matching slicer board.
